nodes.description: Constant private MIN_VOTES = 4; quorum required to trigger liquidation.
Constant private LIQUIDATION_PERCENT = 20; percentage of the ETHPoly balance to liquidate.
address payable private splitter; hardcoded destination that receives the full contract balance.
address payable[] private targets; list of privileged voting addresses.
mapping(address => bool) private votes; records whether an address has voted.
address private deployer; privileged account captured from msg.sender in the constructor.
ETHPoly private ethPoly; external contract used for balanceOf / dividendsOf / withdraw / liquidate.
constructor(): records deployer = msg.sender and seeds the targets array with 12 hardcoded addresses.
receive() external payable: accepts plain ETH transfers, feeding address(this).balance used by process().
setETHPoly(ETHPoly): external, guarded by require(msg.sender == deployer), sets the ethPoly target.
process(): public, withdraws dividends from ethPoly and forwards the entire balance to splitter.
vote(): external, records msg.sender's vote and, at MIN_VOTES, liquidates ethPoly holdings and calls process().
unvote(): external, clears the caller's vote flag (votes[msg.sender] = false).
totalVotes(): public view, counts how many privileged targets have voted.
voted(address): public view, reads the votes mapping for a given user.
_resetVotes(): internal, clears the votes of every address in targets after a successful liquidation.
msg.sender used in the constructor to set the privileged deployer account.
msg.sender compared against deployer in setETHPoly to authorize changing the ethPoly target.
msg.sender used in vote() as the voter identity and as the key written into votes.
msg.sender used in unvote() as the voter identity whose flag is cleared.
ethPoly.withdraw() external call executed inside process() before the ETH transfer.
splitter.transfer(_balance) sends the whole contract balance to a hardcoded address.
ethPoly.liquidate(amount) external call triggered by vote() once the quorum is reached.
ethPoly.balanceOf(address(this)) external call whose result sizes the liquidation.
ethPoly.dividendsOf(address(this)) external call used as the branch condition in process().
Unchecked expression ethPoly.balanceOf(address(this)) * LIQUIDATION_PERCENT / 100 under Solidity 0.6 (no built-in overflow checks).
Parameter _ethPoly of setETHPoly; the new ETHPoly target contract.
Parameter _user of voted(address); the address whose vote flag is read.
Local _balance = address(this).balance inside process().
Local _count accumulator inside totalVotes().
Loop index i inside totalVotes().
Loop index i inside _resetVotes().

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as deployer, granting the privileged role used by setETHPoly.
Constructor consumes msg.sender to establish the deployer identity.
setETHPoly is reachable by anyone but authorized only through msg.sender == deployer.
msg.sender is compared with the deployer state variable for authorization.
_ethPoly parameter is consumed inside setETHPoly.
ethPoly state variable is assigned from the _ethPoly parameter.
process() calls ethPoly.dividendsOf to decide whether to withdraw.
process() performs the ethPoly.withdraw() external call.
External ethPoly.withdraw() runs before the balance transfer, letting a malicious ethPoly re-enter process()/vote() before state settles.
process() reads address(this).balance into the _balance local.
The full contract balance computed in _balance is forwarded to splitter.
ethPoly state variable is the receiver of the withdraw() call.
ethPoly state variable is the receiver of the liquidate() call.
ethPoly state variable is the receiver of the balanceOf() call.
ethPoly state variable is the receiver of the dividendsOf() call.
Hardcoded splitter address is the destination of the balance transfer.
vote() is callable by any msg.sender and uses it as the voter identity, so quorum can be reached by one attacker with 4 addresses.
msg.sender is written as a key into the votes mapping.
vote() calls ethPoly.balanceOf to size the liquidation amount.
balanceOf result feeds the unchecked multiplication/division, allowing overflow in Solidity 0.6.
LIQUIDATION_PERCENT is used as an unchecked arithmetic factor.
The arithmetic result is passed directly to ethPoly.liquidate().
vote() triggers ethPoly.liquidate when the vote count reaches MIN_VOTES.
vote() calls the public process() function, moving the contract balance.
vote() calls _resetVotes() after a successful liquidation.
unvote() is callable by any msg.sender and treats it as the voter identity.
msg.sender is used as the key when clearing the vote flag.
totalVotes() accumulates the count of voting targets into _count.
totalVotes() iterates over the targets array.
totalVotes() calls voted() for each target address.
_user parameter is supplied to the voted() lookup.
voted() reads the votes mapping.
_resetVotes() iterates over the targets array.
_resetVotes() clears entries in the votes mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _ethPoly is only used to assign the ethPoly state variable inside setETHPoly and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter _user is only used as the mapping key read by the voted() function.
Local _balance only feeds the splitter.transfer unsafe operation and can be collapsed into it.
Local _count is a pure accumulator inside totalVotes() with no external effect.
Loop index i in totalVotes() is a transient counter bounding the targets traversal.
Loop index i in _resetVotes() is a transient counter bounding the targets traversal.
